title: cloudfront: support sigv4a signing protocol on aws_cloudfront_origin_access_control (S3 Multi-Region Access Point origins)
body:
### Description

On 2026-08-20 CloudFront announced native Origin Access Control (OAC) support for Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points (MRAP). CloudFront signs requests to an S3-MRAP origin with SigV4a, which removes the need for a Lambda@Edge function that computes the `Authorization` header by hand.

The only new API surface is a new value in the `OriginAccessControlSigningProtocols` enum: `sigv4a`. MRAP origins keep `OriginAccessControlOriginType = s3`, and `SigningBehavior` is unchanged.

title: aws_bedrockagentcore_gateway_rate_limit - Manage rate and token limits on a gateway
body:
### Description

 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway now supports rate limiting that is not yet available in the Terraform provider.
  
  Rate limits allow defining request and connection throttling scoped by dimensions:
 
  - IAM Principal ARN
  - IAM Source Identity
  - OAuth Claim
  - Model
  - Target
  - Tool
  
  This feature is available in the AWS Console and API but missing from Terraform.

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

 * `aws_bedrockagentcore_gateway_rate_limit`

title: [Enhancement]: Support in-place update of approximate_creation_date_time_precision on aws_dynamodb_kinesis_streaming_destination
body:

`aws_dynamodb_kinesis_streaming_destination` marks `approximate_creation_date_time_precision` as `ForceNew`, and the resource has no `Update` function at all — only `Create`, `Read` and `Delete`. Changing the precision therefore plans a destroy-and-recreate:
